resources.string: Verification build for the SOS widget and the SMS engine. The SOS pipeline sends real SMS to the selected SOS contacts.

1. Grant permissions.
2. Add the ImHere widget to the home screen (long press on the home screen → Widgets).
3. Tap the widget once, then a second time within 2 seconds.
4. Watch the notification and the Logcat tags ImHerePrototype and ImHereSms.
5. The SOS button above and the widget send real SMS to SOS contacts. The SMS test section below simulates sending by default; a number ending in 0000 reports a send error.

Location permission: %1$s
Precise location: %2$s
Notification permission: %3$s
SMS permission: %4$s
SIM data permission: %5$s
Location services: %6$s
Google Play services: %7$s
A number ending in 0000 simulates a send error. Delivery reports are simulated too.
SMS and SIM permissions are required.
Permission denied permanently. Open the system settings to enable it manually.
